Name: (CHD) Beornwahl's Anime HD Portraits for Change Dialogue Plus
Author: Gizzlembos03
Description:
This content pack allow Beornwahl's Anime HD portraits to show up on Change Dialogue Plus config.


-- Install --

1. You need this mod and all its requirements

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5335]Change Dialogues plus SVE - CFD - LfL - Razolyn (Spanish and English) - Robin
Romance Mod (English) - Jodi Datable - True Love Valley and Farmerjack's
Dialogue Expansions[/url]

2. Download and install as any other content pack (put zip contents in the mods folder)

- You dont need to install Beornwahl's Anime HD portraits for this to work, the images are included in the mod (he has open permissions at the time i write this). Think of this as an alternate install method if you are using Change Dialogues plus instead of other mod to
replace bachelors or simply to have all the portraits in the same menu.


-- Credits --

All credits go to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/45304212]Beornwahl[/url] for his portraits, i only changed the name of the images.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/74323508]mardrest[/url] for his/her amazing mod Change Dialogues plus that allows to create portraits and sprite packs.
